name: Melee
blurb: Close-range damage with strong durability, plus several weapon families that still let you fight from relative safety.

subclasses.name: True Melee
subclasses.description: Short-range swords, spears, and contact-focused melee weapons.

subclasses.name: Yoyo
subclasses.description: Cursor-controlled yoyos that trade reach and safety for sustained control.

subclasses.name: Boomerang
subclasses.description: Thrown melee weapons that arc out and return.

subclasses.name: Flail
subclasses.description: Chain-based melee options with awkward but powerful area control.

subclasses.name: Projectile Melee
subclasses.description: Melee weapons that fire or hurl a projectile - swords with beams, plus thrown knives and spears.

name: Ranger
blurb: Ammo-based damage with strong boss safety, flexible weapon types, and easy specialization once mobility is online.

subclasses.name: Bows
subclasses.description: Arrow-based ranged setups that scale especially well with ammo effects.

subclasses.name: Guns
subclasses.description: Bullet-firing ranged builds built around sustained pressure.

subclasses.name: Thrown
subclasses.description: Consumable explosives, knives, and other thrown ranged options.

subclasses.name: Launchers
subclasses.description: Rocket-heavy ranged weapons with explosive crowd control.

name: Mage
blurb: Mana-based burst and utility with high ceiling, strong progression spikes, and lower survivability if positioning slips.

subclasses.name: Wands / Staves
subclasses.description: Single-shot spellcasters such as staves and focused magic projectiles.

subclasses.name: Magic Guns
subclasses.description: Rapid-fire magic weapons that behave more like sustained ranged tools.

subclasses.name: Spell Tomes
subclasses.description: Book-based spells that often bring piercing, arcs, or unusual behavior.

subclasses.name: Summon Magic
subclasses.description: Magic tools that create persistent hazards or supporting summons.

name: Summoner
blurb: Minion-focused pressure with whips and support tools that reward positioning, tagging, and encounter knowledge.

subclasses.name: Minions
subclasses.description: Persistent summon slots spent on orbiting or pursuing allies.

subclasses.name: Whips
subclasses.description: Tag-focused melee tools that boost minion target priority and damage.

subclasses.name: Sentries
subclasses.description: Stationary summons that add area control to boss arenas and events.
